title: RefMix: Expanding Endpoint Proposals for Diversity-Preserving Reward Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33957v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online forward matching aligns flow-based generative models by repeatedly generating, rewarding, and fitting model-produced endpoints. However, this behavior creates an on-policy feedback loop: as high-reward modes become increasingly favored, alternative modes become less likely to appear in subsequent training pools, progressively reducing visual diversity. We introduce RefMix, a reference-assisted endpoint proposal strategy that addresses this limitation by injecting alternative candidates into the training pool while retaining the original task reward and forward matching objective. In particular, RefMix uses a reference model during early high-noise steps to expose alternative visual modes, followed by the current reward-tuned model for endpoint completion. Across state-of-the-art online forward matching methods, RefMix consistently improves visual diversity while preserving task reward performance. Controlled inference experiment

translated_title: RefMix：扩展端点提议以实现保持多样性的奖励微调
translated_abstract: 在线前向匹配通过反复生成、奖励评估和拟合模型产生的端点来对齐基于流的生成模型。然而，这种行为会形成一种策略内（on-policy）反馈循环：随着高奖励模式日益受到青睐，其他备选模式在后续训练池中出现的可能性逐渐降低，从而不断削弱视觉多样性。我们提出了 RefMix，一种参考辅助的端点提议策略，通过向训练池中注入备选候选来解决这一局限，同时保留原有的任务奖励与前向匹配目标。具体而言，RefMix 在早期高噪声步骤中使用参考模型来展现备选的视觉模式，随后由当前的奖励微调模型完成端点生成。在多种最先进的在线前向匹配方法上，RefMix 均能持续提升视觉多样性，同时保持任务奖励性能。
tldr: RefMix 通过在早期高噪声步骤借助参考模型注入备选端点候选，打破策略内反馈循环，在保持任务奖励性能的同时显著提升生成结果的视觉多样性。
en_tdlr: RefMix breaks the on-policy feedback loop by injecting alternative endpoint candidates from a reference model during early high-noise steps, consistently improving visual diversity while preserving task reward performance.
